introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Loneliness can affect all people

vocabulary.definition: the state of being alone and feeling isolated or sad
vocabulary.example: She experienced deep loneliness after moving to a new city where she didn't know anyone.

vocabulary.definition: continuing for a long time or longer than usual; extended
vocabulary.example: His prolonged absence from work raised concerns among his colleagues.

vocabulary.definition: the state of not being present or available
vocabulary.example: Her absence at the meeting was noticeable as she was expected to present the project.

vocabulary.definition: important or notable; having a particular meaning or effect
vocabulary.example: The findings of the study had a significant impact on the scientific community.

vocabulary.definition: persisting for a long time or constantly recurring; long-lasting
vocabulary.example: She suffered from chronic back pain that required regular medical attention.

vocabulary.definition: times in life where there are difficulties, challenges, or changes
vocabulary.example: Starting a new job can be one of the pinch points in a person's career.
